lessons_used: Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 7 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 7 tests.
Finish hint, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Two column pick friend layout redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting companion traits alongside pet visual previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step drop-off is high at 69.8% with an 89s median completion time, indicating users need a clearer choice overview.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Perfect Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a companion style to bring your desktop pet to life.

guard.reason: Redesign preserves the screen's core job and remains within onboarding boundaries.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but previous adoption redesign tests averaged -2.4% lift.

candidates.title: Pet naming milestone new screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after picking a friend companion style.
candidates.why: Giving the pet a name early increases emotional attachment and commitment during the adoption step.

new_pet_naming.headline: Give Your Desktop Pet a Name
new_pet_naming.body: Personalize your companion before creating their desktop profile.

guard.reason: Adding a pet naming screen during onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 30.2% of users; new screen changes in adoption averaged +2.1% across 3 tests.

candidates.title: Split layout final welcome redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the finish screen into a split view showing desktop controls alongside a mascot welcome preview.
candidates.why: The finish step has a 64.8% conversion rate and support receives emails asking how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Click and drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Access settings from the system tray.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High funnel drop-off and support mail evidence, but finish redesigns consistently underperform (-3.8% avg).

candidates.title: Two column sign in security redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout showing cloud synchronization reassurance next to authentication options.
candidates.why: Support receives 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Keep your companion settings, custom look, and adoption progress safe in the cloud.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in screen layout and copy complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and sign_in redesign is a proven winner (3/7 tests, +1.0% avg).

candidates.title: Instant setup value headline copy
candidates.change: Update path selection copy to emphasize fast instant companion adoption.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is 8s but mean is 514s, showing some users stall when picking a creation path.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Desktop Pet?
choose_path.body: Pick instant companion adoption for quick setup, or photo upload to customize.

guard.reason: The path selection screen still offers both adopting and making your own.

candidates.score_note: Low implementation cost, but choose_path copy changes have averaged -0.4% across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Starter toy companion welcome incentive
candidates.change: Add a starter accessory badge and callout on the final onboarding screen.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off remains at 35.2%, so an immediate reward increases completion drive.

home_intro.body: Your desktop pet comes pre-equipped with a starter interactive ball toy on your screen.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions included free extras/accessories, violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Desktop ready status background notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app freely.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to get lost or close the app while rendering.

waiting.body: Feel free to use other apps. We will notify you as soon as your desktop companion is ready.

guard.reason: Adding readiness notifications on the waiting screen is permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home notification changes showed negative average lift (-1.9%) with no clear positive effect.

candidates.title: Rendering progress and estimated time wait info
candidates.change: Display progress percentage and clear wait time expectations during companion rendering.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s), indicating uncertainty while waiting.

waiting.hint: Companion setup usually takes 1 to 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Showing wait time and progress estimates for a real wait is allowed by Rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Easy to implement, but home wait_info changes showed no clear effect (+0.5% avg across 2 tests).

candidates.title: Account cloud backup clarity hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in prevents losing adoption progress on app restart.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pets after signing in or reopening.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet to your account so progress and custom looks are saved.

guard.reason: Adding explanatory hint text to sign-in screen complies with base rules.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 8 support emails and cheap to implement, but hint/copy changes on sign_in lack strong track record.

candidates.title: Adoption photo quality guidance hint
candidates.change: Add clear image selection tips on photo upload step to prevent custom pet generation errors.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, front-facing photos for best desktop rendering quality.

guard.reason: Adding guidance hints on the photo upload screen complies with base rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost with 3 support emails pointing to photo upload issues; adoption hint single test showed +3.3%.

Rendering progress and estimated time wait info
